summary: Batch program that updates transaction-type reference records based on user-supplied input. Reads an input file of transaction-type changes and applies them (add/update) to the transaction-type reference file, reporting counts and errors.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the input file and the transaction-type reference file. Loop reading each input update record: apply it to the transaction-type file (update if the type exists, add if it does not), counting successes and errors. Close the files, print the counts, and return.
branches: IF type exists -> update ELSE add

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: transaction-type updates are applied from an input file -- existing types are updated, new ones are added.

paragraphs.name: OPEN-FILES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the input update file for input and the transaction-type reference file for I-O; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: READ-INPUT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next transaction-type update record; set end-of-file at the end.

paragraphs.name: APPLY-UPDATE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the transaction-type record by key; if it exists rewrite it with the new values, otherwise write a new record; count the result and log any error.

paragraphs.name: CLOSE-FILES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close all files and display the update/error counts.
